description: This is a Java class implementation of the ClientService interface, providing methods to manage clients including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, with integration to an external client system via REST API.

classes.name: ClientServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ClientService interface, handling client data and communication with external client system.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a client by ID, fetches project data from external service if projects are empty.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes JSON response from external service to populate client project data.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Makes an HTTP GET request to the predefined URI to fetch client data.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client if it doesn't already exist, throws exception if duplicate.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing client, throws exception if client does not exist.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client by ID, throws exception if client does not exist.
